Subject: Re: Closeflow: weekly MAP checkpoint — procurement & legal gating (MSA redlines / order form)

Lauren / team — short legal update following our internal review and the 10am sync notes:

Summary of legal redline (MSA_redline_v2.docx attached):
- Data retention (Sect. 7): Acme requested explicit 12-month rolling retention for non-PHI analytics. We proposed a 12-month default with an option to extend under written request; they want hard caps.
- SLA / uptime credits: Acme added a stricter SLA definition and an expanded remedies section. We proposed divider language that keeps standard credits but removes open-ended termination rights tied solely to token-level latency.
- Security evidence: Acme's legal asked for SOC 2 attestation and audit log retention policy. Mina — can you confirm the SOC 2 snapshot and a short summary of our audit log retention to share with them by Friday 8/20?

Action items from legal sync (owners & due dates):
- Karthik: produce a clean MSA redline incorporating compromise language for Sect.7 and SLA edits — due Thu 8/19 EOD (MSA_redline_clean.docx).
- Mina: compile SOC2 snapshot + audit-log summary (one-pager) — due Fri 8/20.
- Dev: start vendor setup flow (create vendor record, provision service account skeleton in us-west2) — due Fri 8/20.

I'll circulate the clean redline once the compromise text is finalized. If Acme legal returns a more aggressive position Tuesday evening, we may need a short escalated call.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>

Subject: MAP weekly checkpoint — procurement/legal workflow status (notes + owners)

Team — consolidated checkpoint after our touchpoints this week. Placing the MAP status below so everyone has a single source of truth.

Meeting notes (8/18 MAP sync):
- Attendees: Lauren (Redwood), Karthik (Redwood), Mina (Redwood), Sara (Acme), Tom (Acme procurement).
- Acme legal will return final comments on the redline by EOD 8/18; Redwood legal to provide clean counter-redline by 8/19.
- Procurement confirmed vendor owner and PO preference (net-45). Treasury may request net-30 for early-stage deals; procurement to escalate if necessary.

Status summary:
- MSA redline: REDLINE_IN_PROGRESS — Redwood to send MSA_redline_clean.docx by 8/19.
- Order form: READY_FOR_SIGNOFF_PENDING_BILLING — Acme provided billing contact and net-45. Redwood finance needs PO number for invoicing.
- Vendor setup: IN_PROGRESS — Dev to provision skeleton in us-west2 and upload vendor profile to vendor portal.

Action items (owners / due dates):
1) Karthik — Finalize and send clean MSA redline (MSA_redline_clean.docx) to Acme legal — due 2027-08-19 EOD.
2) Mina — SOC 2 snapshot + audit-log retention one-pager to Acme legal & procurement — due 2027-08-20 EOD.
3) Dev — Create vendor record, begin provisioning (service account + minimal IAM) for testing in us-west2; upload vendor docs to portal — due 2027-08-20.
4) Lauren — Coordinate PO routing and confirm final billing address with Acme; prep order form for signature once PO is received — due 2027-08-24.

Risks / blockers:
- If Acme legal insists on retention language that conflicts with our baseline, we'll need an executive exception for that clause — possible escalation to GTM and product.
- PO number delay will push invoice creation and therefore vendor provisioning (estimated 3 business days after PO).

Next checkpoint / asks:
- Please update completed items in the shared MAP sheet (Drive link above). If any owner needs an extension, call it out in this thread.
- Proposed next short sync: Tue 8/24 at 9am PT to confirm final redline and PO status (15m).

Thanks all — concise readout appreciated.

—Lauren
